About the Show

Nothing is
wasted.

Becoming, With Purpose is for the person asking , I've been through the worst of everything. Now what?

Hosted by Michaela, speaker, podcast host, and someone who knows what it's like to lose everything and find purpose on the other side. Almost five years clean. Still becoming. Talking about resilience, faith, and growth every Sunday.

Not one moment. Not one hard season. Not one story is ever wasted.

"Growth isn't always planned. But it always has purpose." — Michaela
